say:3:1623485003:1.female: If I need to, I'll show up and take control.

say:0:1623486001:0.text: Hey, why are you stopping me?

say:1:1623486002:0.text: The seminar's supposed to be open to everyone!
say:1:1623486002:0.source_cn: 研讨会应该允许所有人进入！

say:1:1623487001:1.text: Reeo... yeah, I can't let you in.
say:1:1623487001:1.source_cn: 雷欧啊雷欧，我可不能让你进去。

say:2:1623487002:1.text: After what you did last time, the newspaper's made it clear they don't want you anywhere near this event.
say:2:1623487002:1.source_cn: 鉴于你上次在研讨会的过激行为，你已经被我们秘闻社列为不...

say:3:1623487003:1.text: We're trying to keep things calm today. So you're done here. You get it, right?
say:3:1623487003:1.source_cn: 为了保证今天的会议顺利进行，我不得不忍痛将你请离会场。...

say:4:1623487004:1.text: And if I refuse to leave?

say:5:1623487005:1.text: Then we'll make you. We're not taking chances today.
say:5:1623487005:1.source_cn: 那就别怪我……为了大家的安全，我们只好采取一些“必要的...

say:6:1623487006:1.text: Things are clearly about to escalate. To avoid tipping anyone off, you give Reeo a pat on the shoulder, and nudge him away from the entrance. At the same time, you shoot him a look, warning him not to do anything rash.
say:6:1623487006:1.source_cn: 眼看事态将要升级，为了不打草惊蛇，你拍了拍雷欧的肩膀，...

say:7:1623487007:1.text: That's better. An unwanted guest planting himself at the door will spoil the mood of the event.
say:7:1623487007:1.source_cn: 对嘛，不受欢迎的人堵在门口，只会让别的同学感到不快。

say:8:1623487008:1.text: Alright, everyone else, go on in.

say:9:1623487009:2.source_cn: 雷欧看懂了你的眼神，他深吸一口气，强压怒火转身离去。

say:0:1623488001:0.source_cn: 很好，你也学会识时务了呢

say:0:1623489001:1.text: The venue is unusually crowded today. You notice Bel keeping close to Olaya, speaking to her in a low voice the whole time, while Olaya looks uncomfortable.
say:0:1623489001:1.source_cn: 今天的会场格外拥挤，你注意到巴布一直在奥莱雅身边低声交...

say:0:1623489001:1.female: The venue is unusually crowded today. You notice Bel keeping close to Olaya, speaking to her in a low voice the whole time, while Olaya looks uncomfortable.

say:2:1623489002:1.text: Only when the host steps onto the stage does the loud chatter across the plaza suddenly die down.
say:2:1623489002:1.source_cn: 直到主持人走上台，广场上喧闹的人声才骤然安静下来。

say:3:1623489003:1.text: Everyone, welcome! Today's seminar is officially starting!
say:3:1623489003:1.source_cn: 亲爱的同学们，今天的研讨会正式开始！

say:4:1623489004:1.text: We're honored to have our special guest with us today. She's not a reporter. She's the founder of a support group that has helped many students through dark times, and she has extensive experience dealing with mana anxiety. Please welcome Olaya!
say:4:1623489004:1.source_cn: 我们非常荣幸地邀请到今日的特邀嘉宾——她并非记者，而是...

say:7:1623489005:2.text: Olaya forces a smile as she walks onstage. A wave of loud applause breaks out.
say:7:1623489005:2.source_cn: 奥莱雅勉强微笑着走上台，台下响起一片热烈的掌声。

say:8:1623489006:1.text: I'm sure you all have a lot you want to ask, so let's skip the formalities and go straight to questions! Raise your hand and speak.
say:8:1623489006:1.source_cn: 相信各位心中已有许多疑问，那我们不必客套，直接进入提问...

say:10:1623489007:1.text: I'll go first! Be honest with us. Is magic messing us up? Should we stop using it?
say:10:1623489007:1.source_cn: 我先问！魔法真的在伤害我们吗？是不是该放弃魔法？

say:13:1623489009:1.text: Um... this "low-mana therapy" everyone's talking about—does it really help? How does it work?
say:13:1623489009:1.source_cn: 请问……低魔力疗法，真的能缓解魔法焦虑吗？能不能讲讲原理？

say:15:1623489010:1.text: Ever since my mana got damaged, I'm scared every time I cast. I'm terrified I'll lose control. What am I supposed to do?
say:15:1623489010:1.source_cn: 自从我魔力受损以来，我每次施法都害怕失控……我到底该怎么办？

say:17:1623489011:1.text: I've started to hate magic... How do I change that?
say:17:1623489011:1.source_cn: 我已经开始厌恶魔法了……我该怎么做才能改变这样的想法？

say:18:1623489012:2.text: One heavy question after another is thrown at Olaya. She falls into a long silence. The whole venue goes quiet.
say:18:1623489012:2.source_cn: 一个个沉重的问题接连抛向台上的奥莱雅，她陷入漫长的沉默...

say:20:1623489013:1.text: A lot of people around me are dealing with the same thing I am. Their mana's been damaged too, and ever since then they've been lost and helpless... Olaya, they came here today as well.
say:20:1623489013:1.source_cn: 我身边有不少同学，都像我这样，因为魔力受损而茫然和萎靡...

say:21:1623489014:1.source_cn: 你有办法帮我们的，对不对？

say:22:1623489015:2.text: That question was basically the last straw for Olaya. You can see the confusion in her eyes, and her fingers curl up without her even noticing.
say:22:1623489015:2.source_cn: 这个问题像最后一根稻草，彻底压垮了奥莱雅。你察觉到，她...
say:22:1623489015:2.male: That question was basically the last straw for Olaya. You can see the confusion in her eyes, and her fingers curl up without her even noticing.
say:22:1623489015:2.female: That question was basically the last straw for Olaya. You can see the confusion in her eyes, and her fingers curl up without her even noticing.

say:24:1623489016:1.text: She scans the crowd, clearly a little shaken, like she's searching for something, then she just locks onto you.
say:24:1623489016:1.source_cn: 她无助的目光在人群中慌乱地扫过，像在寻找一个锚点，最终...
say:24:1623489016:1.male: She scans the crowd, clearly a little shaken, like she's searching for something, then she just locks onto you.
say:24:1623489016:1.female: She scans the crowd, clearly a little shaken, like she's searching for something, then she just locks onto you.

say:26:1623489017:1.text: She takes a deep breath. Her voice shakes a little, but her words come out clear and serious.
say:26:1623489017:1.source_cn: 她深吸一口气，声音有些发颤，但却清晰而严肃。

say:29:1623489019:1.source_cn: 假的？什么意思？你在说什么？

say:30:1623489020:1.text: Bel's piece was made up. All of it. I never created some "low-mana therapy", and I never told anyone to hate magic. That's not me!
say:30:1623489020:1.source_cn: 巴布的那篇文章是假的，我从未开发过低魔力疗法，更没有引...

say:31:1623489021:1.text: The support group is real. We do help students with damaged mana. But there's only so much we can do... People aren't getting better the way the article claimed.
say:31:1623489021:1.source_cn: 互助团队的确是在帮助魔力受损的同学，但我们能做的事情很...

say:34:1623489022:1.text: The crowd erupts. Bel and a few reporters look suddenly alarmed.
say:34:1623489022:1.source_cn: 现场顿时一片哗然，巴布与几名记者脸上瞬间浮现慌乱之色。

say:1:1623491001:1.text: Reeo grabs an Echo Flower and walks straight onto the stage. Bel is too shocked to react—he just stares, mouth hanging open. He doesn't even try to stop him.
say:1:1623491001:1.source_cn: 雷欧手中紧握着回音花，坚定地走上台。或许是因为太过震惊...

say:2:1623491002:1.text: Hey. I'm Reeo. Some of you remember me. Yeah, I'm the student who got branded as "the troublemaker who disrupted the seminar". And I'm still a reporter who actually cares about what's true.
say:2:1623491002:1.source_cn: 大家好，我是雷欧。想必你们之中有人还记得我——是的，我...

say:3:1623491003:1.text: You've noticed it, right? The school newspaper's been getting more and more dramatic. It used to tell you what happened. Now it feels like it's trying to get you worked up.
say:3:1623491003:1.source_cn: 同学们，你们真的没有感觉到吗？这段时间以来，学校的新闻...

say:4:1623491004:1.text: When you hear stuff like that over and over, it gets to you. You stop asking what's true. You just get pulled along by the hype.
say:4:1623491004:1.source_cn: 那些被刻意夸大的言论包裹着我们的耳朵，捂住了我们的眼睛...

say:5:1623491005:1.text: And today, I just want you to hear what's really behind all this, not the sensational story they printed.
say:5:1623491005:1.source_cn: 而今天，我只想让你们听到久违的真相——那隐藏在所谓“爆...

say:6:1623491006:1.text: So just give me one minute. Stay quiet and listen to a recording I captured with this Echo Flower.
say:6:1623491006:1.source_cn: 请大家安静片刻，听一段我通过回音花采集到的现场录音。

say:7:1623491007:1.text: The students trade silent looks as the room slowly quiets down. Reeo switches on the Echo Flower, and the recorded voices begin to play.
say:7:1623491007:1.source_cn: 学生们面面相觑，但最后还是安静了下来。雷欧激活了回音花...

say:9:1623491008:1.text: "As long as you steer the Lyceum's public opinion in the way we want, we'll bump your pay up to the top tier, just like Bel's."
say:9:1623491008:1.source_cn: “只要按照我们要求的方向去引导莱希拉姆的舆论，你未来的...

say:10:1623491009:1.text: "Those weaklings who can't handle their magic or the pressure—they don't belong in the Lyceum anyway!"
say:10:1623491009:1.source_cn: “那些魔力受损、心理承受能力又差劲的废物，本来就不配留...

say:11:1623491010:1.text: "Money decides what I write, simple as that."
say:11:1623491010:1.source_cn: “报酬的多少，直接决定了我的笔尖朝向哪边。”

say:12:1623491011:1.text: "And since we're being honest, those nasty hit pieces that dragged them through the mud? Yeah. I wrote those too."
say:12:1623491011:1.source_cn: “不怕告诉你们，之前那些丑化他们的爆款文章，也全都出自...

say:13:1623491012:1.text: "Only rookies get all precious about 'the truth'. The smart ones just do whatever gets them paid."
say:13:1623491012:1.source_cn: “只有刚入行的新手，才会天真地死抱着所谓的“真相”不放...

say:14:1623491013:1.text: "Hah. I like you, Bel. You get it. We'll keep you on long-term."
say:14:1623491013:1.source_cn: “哈哈……巴布，我很欣赏你的想法，我们会长期找你合作的。”

say:17:1623491014:1.text: That's what I came to show you. You're students here. You can judge for yourselves what's real and what's been pushed on you.
say:17:1623491014:1.source_cn: 以上，就是我今天想要给大家展示的所有内容。事实如何，作...

say:1:1623494001:1.text: Synchronized footsteps echo across the ground. Patrol soldiers arrive in formation and quickly surround the mystery merchant and his thugs. Walking right behind them is Zorya, calm as ever.
say:1:1623494001:1.source_cn: 一阵整齐的脚步声传来，你看到巡逻士兵们列队前来，将神秘...
say:1:1623494001:1.male: Synchronized footsteps echo across the ground. Patrol soldiers arrive in formation and quickly surround the mystery merchant and his thugs. Walking right behind them is Zorya, calm as ever.
say:1:1623494001:1.female: Synchronized footsteps echo across the ground. Patrol soldiers arrive in formation and quickly surround the mystery merchant and his thugs. Walking right behind them is Zorya, calm as ever.

say:2:1623494002:1.text: Under our agreement with the Lightbearer Empire, you'll take the outsiders for questioning. I'll handle the students.
say:2:1623494002:1.source_cn: 依照莱希拉姆同耀光帝国的协议，这些校外人士理应交由你们...

say:3:1623494003:1.text: When you get something, send word to me.
say:3:1623494003:1.source_cn: 审讯有结果时，请派人通知我。

say:5:1623494005:3.text: The soldiers move fast and know exactly what they're doing, escorting people away and securing the area. Bel keeps begging Zorya for mercy. And of course, it doesn't get him anywhere.
say:5:1623494005:3.source_cn: 巡逻士兵们开始熟练地押解人员、清点现场。巴布则不停向佐...

say:7:1623494006:2.text: In the midst of the noisy cleanup, Reeo sits on the ground, looking dazed.
say:7:1623494006:2.source_cn: 在一片略显嘈杂的收尾工作中，雷欧坐在地上，似乎因为刚才...

say:8:1623494007:1.text: ... It's done? I... I actually pulled it off?!

say:10:1623494008:1.text: You did. You did really well.

say:11:1623494009:1.text: Uh... Headmistress Zorya?! I thought... I mean, just now I...

say:12:1623494010:1.text: Easy. No need to panic. Merlin told me what was going on.
say:12:1623494010:1.source_cn: 不必惊讶，也无需紧张，梅林早已将一切告知于我。
say:12:1623494010:1.male: Easy. No need to panic. Merlin told me what was going on.
say:12:1623494010:1.female: Easy. No need to panic. Merlin told me what was going on.

say:13:1623494011:1.text: I'm glad the Lyceum has someone like you.
say:13:1623494011:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆有你这样的学生，我很高兴。

say:16:1623494013:1.text: So the school had a plan the whole time. I had no idea... ow, it's bleeding again.
say:16:1623494013:1.source_cn: 原来学校对这一切早有准备……我、我真没想到……哎呦，伤...
say:16:1623494013:1.male: So the school had a plan the whole time. I had no idea... ow, it's bleeding again.
say:16:1623494013:1.female: So the school had a plan the whole time. I had no idea... ow, it's bleeding again.

say:17:1623494014:1.text: First things first. Let's get you patched up. Everything else can wait.
say:17:1623494014:1.source_cn: 先处理伤势，其他的以后再说。

say:0:1623495001:0.text: Reeo. Come here, let me take care of that.
say:0:1623495001:0.source_cn: 雷欧……我先帮你处理一下伤口吧。
say:0:1623495001:0.male: Reeo. Come here, let me take care of that.
say:0:1623495001:0.female: Reeo. Come here, let me take care of that.

say:1:1623496001:1.source_cn: 你对雷欧使用了治疗术，他摸了摸头上的伤口——已经完全愈合了。

choice_prompt:3:1623496002.male: Thanks, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm glad I got to be here with you for all of this.
choice_prompt:3:1623496002.female: Thanks, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm glad I got to be here with you for all of this.

say:4:1623496003:1.text: I just did what felt right. This is my school, and I'm a reporter. I can't just keep quiet.
say:4:1623496003:1.source_cn: 我……我只是做了我应该做的事情。毕竟，我是莱希拉姆的学...
say:4:1623496003:1.male: I just did what felt right. This is my school, and I'm a reporter. I can't just keep quiet.
say:4:1623496003:1.female: I just did what felt right. This is my school, and I'm a reporter. I can't just keep quiet.

say:5:1623496004:1.text: People were lying about magic to push their own agenda. I wasn't going to sit there and let that happen.
say:5:1623496004:1.source_cn: 作为魔法学生，我不能眼睁睁看着魔法之道被别有用心的人污蔑。
say:5:1623496004:1.male: People were lying about magic to push their own agenda. I wasn't going to sit there and let that happen.
say:5:1623496004:1.female: People were lying about magic to push their own agenda. I wasn't going to sit there and let that happen.

say:6:1623496005:1.text: And for me, this is the job. I dig up the truth, and I put it out there so people can see it.
